scope: 压缩/上下文不可重试失败后的自动派发门禁；不重写架构、不部署应用

tests.command: cargo test --locked -p xharness-session -p xharness-agent -p xharness-host -p xharness-schedule --lib --tests
ignored_tests: test restore::dynamic_projection_tests::offline_dynamic_projection_stress ... ignored, bounded dynamic replay; explicit CI/local incident investigation only
test restore::tests::offline_authoritative_restore_100_cold_starts ... ignored, explicit isolated cold-start acceptance; run in diagnostics CI
test restore::tests::offline_journal_projection_stress ... ignored, explicit offline projection experiment; private journals stay local
test restore::tests::offline_reasoning_projection_stress ... ignored, offline crash-reproduction stress; run explicitly in CI
test restore_checkpoint::tests::recovery_checkpoint_performance_acceptance ... ignored, explicit remote cold-recovery performance acceptance
test runtime::tests::max_tokens_diagnostic::diagnostic_max_tokens_notice_survives_next_turn_start ... ignored, diagnostic of known notice mismatch; run explicitly, remove when fixed

clippy.command: cargo clippy --locked -p xharness-session -p xharness-agent -p xharness-host -p xharness-schedule --lib --tests -- -D warnings

negative_control.description: 远程临时隔离副本只恢复旧的显式暂停门禁；测试与其余实现保持当前版。该副本自动清理，不覆盖正式同步目录。

asserted_boundaries: 真实 LoopEngine 无收益压缩失败，历史保留
连续/迟到回执及 Wake 不再进入 Token Counter/Provider
旧失败日志重启仍停放；Host 回执去重
Host admission 元数据中的真实用户可恢复
用户恢复和 Claim 同一 CAS；撤销/过期 Claim 不能解锁
健康会话的通知继续处理
手动 Compact 完成/NoBenefit 不能误解锁
Goal 既有暂态网络退避与错误原因保留
迟到 retryable 故障不能覆盖用户停止
旧 v1 Idle Recovery Checkpoint 回退权威重放；新 v2 继续复用缓存
limitations: 模型传输和计数为确定性测试 Provider；不是模型推理性能或真实端点验收
6 项既有诊断/压力/已知 notice 用例保持忽略，不计为通过
未运行整个 workspace 或跨平台 GitHub CI
未提交、推送、创建 PR、发布或重启软件
压缩仍可合法返回无收益错误，本修复阻止后续回执自动重复失败
